items.title: 22.6.1 Phenols mein -OH group ke reactions (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 22.6.1, printed pages 92-93 (PDF 95-96).

blocks.text: Phenols ka -OH group halka sa acidic hai. Is liye phenol acid ka kaam kar sakta hai aur acid-base reactions mein hissa leta hai.

Phenols paani mein bohat kam ghulte hain, kyunke in ka bara benzene ring non-polar hai. Lekin yeh alkaline (base wale) solutions mein ghul jate hain: base se acid-base reaction kar ke ghulne wala salt aur paani banate hain.

blocks.alt: Phenol (acid), OH wala benzene ring, + NaOH (base) se sodium phenoxide, O- Na+ wala ring, + H2O. Labels: phenol, sodium hydroxide, sodium phenoxide.
blocks.caption: i) Phenol aur sodium hydroxide (kitab ke PDF safha 95 ki be-number figure ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Phenol yahan acid hai aur NaOH base. Phenol ka H⁺ OH⁻ se mil kar paani banata hai, aur sodium phenoxide (C₆H₅O⁻Na⁺) ka ghulne wala salt bachta hai.
Pighla hua (molten) phenol sodium (Na) jaisi reactive metals se zor se react karta hai. Yeh bhi acid-base reaction hai. Is mein ghulne wala salt banta hai aur hydrogen gas nikalti hai.

blocks.alt: 2 phenol + 2Na se 2 sodium phenoxide (O- Na+ wala ring) + H2. Labels: phenol, sodium, sodium phenoxide.
blocks.caption: ii) Phenol aur sodium (kitab ke PDF safha 95 ki be-number figure ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ki equation mein baen taraf sirf ek phenol aur 2Na chhapa hai, jab ke daen taraf 2 sodium phenoxide hain, yani equation balanced nahi. Sahi: 2 phenol + 2Na → 2 sodium phenoxide + H₂, jaisa hamare khaake mein hai.

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Har phenol ka O-H bond toot'ta hai; O⁻ sodium ke Na⁺ ke saath salt banata hai aur do phenol molecules ke do H mil kar ek H₂ molecule banate hain.

Phenol ko base ki maujoodgi mein acyl chloride ke saath garam karne par ester banta hai. Base phenol se proton hata kar (deprotonate kar ke) phenoxide ion banata hai. Phenoxide ion asal phenol molecule se behtar nucleophile (positive carbon par hamla karne wala) hai, is liye yeh carbonyl carbon par hamla kar sakta hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab kehti hai ke phenol aur acyl chloride ke reaction se ether banta hai. Product, phenyl ethanoate (CH₃COOC₆H₅), ester hai, jaisa kitab ki apni equation dikhati hai.

blocks.alt: Khuli banawat wala ethanoyl chloride, CH3-C(=O)-Cl, + phenol, HO-C6H5, teer ke oopar NaOH aur neeche Heat, se phenyl ethanoate, CH3-C(=O)-O-C6H5, + HCl.
blocks.caption: iii) Ethanoyl chloride aur phenol se phenyl ethanoate (kitab ke PDF safha 96 ki be-number figure ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.alt: Hydroxide ion apne lone pair se (mura teer) phenol ke O-H ka H leta hai, aur doosra mura teer O-H bond ke electrons ko O par le jata hai. Natija phenoxide ion, 'better nucleophile than the phenol', + H2O.
blocks.caption: Phenol aur hydroxide ion se phenoxide ion (kitab ke PDF safha 96 ki be-number figure ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: OH⁻ ka lone pair phenol ke H ko kheenchta hai (pehla mura teer) aur O-H bond ke electrons O par chale jate hain (doosra mura teer). Bachne wala phenoxide ion manfi hai, is liye phenol se behtar nucleophile hai aur ethanoyl chloride ke carbonyl carbon par hamla karta hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ke khaake mein OH⁻ ke proton lene se banne wala paani (H₂O) nahi likha; hamare khaake mein '+ H₂O' shamil hai.
Phenol ka yeh reaction Chapter 24 (Organic Nitrogen Compounds) mein bayan hoga.

blocks.prompt: Phenol sodium hydroxide ke solution mein kyun ghul jata hai, jab ke paani mein bohat kam ghulta hai?
blocks.explanation: Paani mein bara non-polar ring ghulne nahi deta; NaOH phenol ke acidic -OH se react kar ke ionic salt, sodium phenoxide, banata hai jo paani mein ghul jata hai.

items: Phenol + NaOH → sodium phenoxide + paani; phenol + Na → sodium phenoxide + H₂.
Phenol + acyl chloride (base, garmi) → ester (phenyl ethanoate); base phenoxide ion banata hai jo behtar nucleophile hai.
Diazonium ions se reaction Chapter 24 mein.
